```plato
    // The faces meeting at an undirected edge: two for an interior edge, one for
    // a boundary edge. Read from the naming corner and its twin rather than by
    // scanning, which keeps this quadratic instead of cubic.
    FacesOfUndirectedEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Array<FaceIndex>
    {
        var corner = self.CanonicalCornerOfUndirectedEdge(edge);
        var twin = self.TwinCorner(corner);
        return twin.IsNone
            ? [self.CornerFace(corner)]
            : [self.CornerFace(corner), self.CornerFace(twin)];
    }
}
```
